> WHAT IS THIS?
> Gaia is a sovereign living digital organism: 17 compiled Rust
> binaries (primals), 23 autonomous mushroom scripts, 52 cron
> heartbeats, 63 local AI models (ollama), running on commodity
> hardware in two houses connected by 10G fiber in Michigan.
> No cloud. No corporate dependency. Fully self-hosted.
> Current routes: 183. REEDit posts: 1814. Bestiary: 48 cards.
